info.title: Token Controller API
info.description: The versioned REST API of Token Controller. Everything the web app does goes through it. See docs.tokencontroller.com/reference/api.

get.summary: The latest revision of every bill, newest period first.

403.description: Only a controller can read bills

post.summary: Send a bill for a period.
post.description:
Stores a new revision when the figures differ from the latest one, and
answers 200 with the unchanged bill when they do not.

200.description: The same figures were already stored

400.description: The figures cannot be read or do not add up

403.description: Only a controller can send bills

get.summary: Every revision of one bill, oldest first.
The cadences of the organization and its projects.

put.summary:
Set the cadence of the organization or of one project. A people manager
sets a project's cadence within the filters they are assigned.

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

delete.summary: Remove a cadence: its token sheets are no longer due.
Revoke a link: it stops working at once.

get.summary:
Everything the organization has, as a zip of JSON files. Controllers
only.
Is the service up and can it reach its database?

Every period from the first with a token entry or a bill up to this
month, newest first.
One period and what is still open in it.

post.summary: Post a signed correction to a closed period.

201.description: Posted; the cost sheet with it

400.description: The amount or reason is missing

post.summary:
Close a period: lock its token entries and keep the tag map, price table
and bills it closed with. Answers with the cost sheet.

403.description: Only a controller can close a period

409.description: The period cannot close yet; the message says why

get.summary:
The cost sheet of a period: final once it is closed, a preview while it
is open.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Extra tag names as columns, comma-separated, such as `team,purpose`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for a CSV file; JSON otherwise.

200.description: The cost sheet, as JSON or CSV

get.summary: The links made for a period.

post.summary: Make a link that shows the cost sheet without signing in.

get.summary: Each bill of a period against its token entries, with residual.

403.description: Only a controller can read the reconciliation

get.summary: Cost by agent harness, agent name, model, effort or speed.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show the report in another currency, such as `USD`.

200.description: The report, as JSON or CSV

400.description: `by` is not one of the agent harness cuts

get.summary:
Cost grouped by any tag, within a filter: the reporting API's main
report.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show the report in another currency, such as `USD`.

200.description: The report, as JSON or CSV

400.description: The filter, grouping or currency cannot be read

get.summary: Tickets that cost far more or less than similar past tickets.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only tickets matching this tag filter, such as `client:acme`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many tickets to list, 20 when left out.

200.description: The outliers, as JSON or CSV

get.summary: The saved reports of the organization, by name.

post.summary: Save a tag filter with a grouping as a report.

400.description: No name, no grouping, or a filter that cannot be read

get.summary: A saved report for one period.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show the report in another currency, such as `USD`.

200.description: The report, as JSON or CSV

delete.summary: Remove a saved report. Its creator or a controller can.

404.description: No such saved report of yours

get.summary:
Token budget vs actual: one row per token budget in force for the
period, with the token budget, the actual cost and the difference.
Token budgets overlap, so the rows are never added up.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period, such as `2026-09`. Left out: this month.

200.description: Token budget vs actual, as JSON or CSV

get.summary:
One token budget opened down to the tickets (by their `ticket` tag) and
token entries behind its actual, for a period it is in force in.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period, such as `2026-09`. Left out: this month.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description:
The table the CSV file holds: `tickets` (the default) or
`token_entries`.

200.description: The token budget's actual opened down, as JSON or CSV

400.description: The period or table is not valid

409.description: The token budget is not in force in the period, or an exchange rate is missing

get.summary:
Token entries with their splits, tags and summaries, within the caller's
role.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period, such as `2026-09`. Left out: all time.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Statuses, comma separated, out of `submitted`, `approved`,
`rejected` and `locked`. Left out: every status that counts.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
`csv` for a CSV file of every matching token entry, one row per
split.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Token entries per page, up to 5000.

200.description: Token entries, as a JSON page or one CSV file

400.description: The filter or a status cannot be read

get.summary: The cost sheet behind a link, without signing in.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: The secret part of the link

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Extra tag names as columns, comma-separated, such as `team,purpose`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for a CSV file; JSON otherwise.

200.description: The cost sheet, as JSON or CSV

404.description: No such link, or it was revoked

post.summary:
Make a token forecast for a ticket from similar past work: its title
and description are compared with the summaries of past token entries,
and the median actual cost of the best-matching past tickets is
proposed. Nothing is planned until a person accepts it.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The ticket key, such as KD-214

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

409.description: Token forecasts are off on this instance or for this organization, the ticket has no text, or the model failed; the message says which

get.summary:
The token budgets you may see: a controller all of them, a people
manager those within their filters, an agent manager those on their own
person. They can overlap; never add them up.

200.description: The token budgets, as JSON or CSV

post.summary:
Set a token budget on a tag filter: for one period, every month from a
period on, or all time. People managers set them within the filters they
are assigned, controllers anywhere.

400.description: The filter, period or amount is not valid

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

put.summary:
Change a token budget. Both its old and its new filter must lie within
the filters you are assigned.

400.description: The filter, period or amount is not valid

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

delete.summary: Remove a token budget. It no longer shows in token budget vs actual.

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

get.summary:
Submitted token entries waiting for approval, within the caller's
filters.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period, such as `2026-09`. Left out: every open period.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A tag filter in the URL form, such as `team:web,client:acme`.

200.description: Token entries waiting for approval, as JSON or CSV

post.summary: Approve submitted token entries, one by one or in bulk.

Send a token entry back to its agent manager with a reason. It does not
count until it is fixed and submitted again.

404.description: No such token entry within your filters

409.description: The token entry is in a closed period

get.summary:
Whether token forecasts are on for the organization and available on
this instance.

put.summary:
Switch token forecasts on or off for the organization. Token budgets
work either way.

403.description: Only a controller can switch token forecasts

post.summary:
Accept a token forecast: it becomes a token budget on its ticket for
all time. Keep only some matches, or type the amount instead.

400.description: The amount or a match is not valid

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

409.description: Already accepted, or there is no amount to accept

get.summary:
Late token sheets: whose, and for which cadence period. A people manager
sees the people within their filters; an agent manager their own.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Only cadence periods overlapping this month, such as `2026-09`.

get.summary: The caller's own review list: rejected token entries and token sheets.

AcceptInput.description: How to accept a token forecast.

amount.description: Type the amount instead, in the reporting currency, such as `45.00`.

tickets.description:
Keep only these matches, by ticket key: the token budget is their
median cost. Left out: the proposal as it is.

AdjustmentInput.description: An adjustment to post (docs: Account > Adjustments).

amount.description: Plus or minus, in the reporting currency, such as `-120.00`.

reason.example: Provider credit for the September outage

tags.description:
The cost object and any other tags, such as `{"ticket": "KD-214"}`.
No tags puts it on the organization.

AdjustmentLine.description: An adjustment to a closed period that counts in actual.

late.description: Posted from a token sheet submitted after its period closed.

AdjustmentRow.description: An adjustment as the cost sheet shows it.

late.description: Posted for a token sheet that came in after the close.

posted_by.description: Who posted it; `null` for a late token sheet, posted on its own.

ApproveInput.description:
Token entries to approve: by ID, or everything matching a filter and
period.

token_entry_ids.description:
These token entries. Left out: every submitted token entry matching
`period` and `filter` that the caller may approve.

Baseline.description: What a ticket was compared with.

BillInput.description:
A bill as the bills endpoint and the web app send it (docs: Reference >
Bill schema). Amounts are decimal strings in `currency`.

exchange_rate.description:
To the organization's reporting currency, at the bill's date. Left
out, Token Controller fills it in.

gross.description:
Before discount and credit. Left out, it is net plus discount plus
credit.

typed_in.description: Typed in by hand in the web app, rather than sent by a program.

BillLine.description:
One line of the bill that is not a token entry, in the reporting
currency: residual, discount or credit of one provider.

BillSource.description: How a bill reached Token Controller.

exchange_rate.description:
To the reporting currency; `null` until a rate for the bill's date is
known.

exchange_rate_given.description:
Whether the rate came with the bill, rather than from the reference
rates.

revision.description: 1 for the first figure, higher after each restatement.

every_days.description:
For a custom cadence: the length of each cadence period in days,
from 1 to 366.

project.description: The project's name; left out for the whole organization.

starts_on.description:
The day the first cadence period starts. Left out: the Monday of
this week.

CadenceKind.description: How often token sheets are due.

CadencePeriod.description: One stretch of a cadence: from `starts_on` up to and including `ends_on`.

CadenceView.description: A cadence as the API shows it.

every_days.description: For a custom cadence: the length of each cadence period in days.

project.description: The project it is set for; `null` for the whole organization.

starts_on.description: The day the first cadence period starts.

Check.description: Whether one part of the service works.

CostKind.description: How specific a split's cost object is.

CostRow.description:
One line of cost: everything with the same cost object, cost kind and
extra columns.

cost_object.description: The cost object, such as `KD-214`; empty for the organization.

estimate.description:
Whether the amount is a list-price estimate from a provider without a
bill, such as a seat plan.

rung.description:
The rung the cost object sits on, such as `ticket`, or
`organization`.

tags.description:
The value of every rung of the ladder the cost carries, such as the
ticket's project, and of each extra column asked for.

unknown_model.description:
Token entries on a model missing from the price table: counted, never
valued as zero.

closed.description: False while the period is open: the figures can still change.

columns.description: The extra tag names asked for as columns.

ladder.description: The ladder the cost objects were read with, most specific first.

total.description:
Token entries plus residual, minus discount and credit, plus
adjustments.

CostSheetLink.description: A link to a cost sheet.

url.description: The address to hand finance. Shown only when the link is made.

CostSource.description:
How a provider charges for what a bill covers. Seats and subscriptions
are flat fees and have no bill.

CurrentSheet.description:
The cadence period running for a person, as the CLI and the Claude Code
mod show it.

late.description: Whether an earlier cadence period still waits for its token sheet.

skipped.description:
Asked for by ID, but not submitted or not within the caller's
filters.

EntryStatus.description: Where a token entry stands (docs: Reference > Data model, status).

automatic.description: Arrived with no person involved, such as from CI.

list_value.description: The list value of all splits; `null` when the model is unknown.

rejected_reason.description: Why a people manager sent it back.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

message.description: What went wrong, in plain English.

Estimate.description:
Token entries from a provider without a bill this period, such as a seat
plan: their list value is an estimate at API prices.

Filter.description: A set of tags. The empty filter matches everything.

ForecastMatch.description: One past ticket a token forecast matched.

actual.description: Its actual cost over all time, in the reporting currency.

confidence.description: How alike its token entries' summaries are to the ticket, in percent.

unknown_model_entries.description:
Token entries on a model missing from the price table: their cost is
not known, so this ticket is left out of the proposal.

Health.description: The answer of the health endpoint.

edition.description: `open`, or the edition the Enterprise plan build reports.

KindTotals.description: Cost per cost kind: how specific the attribution is.

direct_percent.description: Each kind's share of all token entries, in percent.

OpenItems.description:
What still needs a look before a period closes (docs: Account > Monthly
close, steps 1 to 3).

late_token_sheets.description:
Token sheets whose cadence period is over and that were not
submitted.

organization_overhead.description: Organization overhead: cost on no project that may belong on one.

rejected.description: Token entries sent back to their agent manager.

unapproved.description: With approval on: token entries not approved yet.

unknown_model.description: Token entries on a model missing from the price table.

Outcome.description: How actual compares with the token budget.

Outlier.description: One ticket far from its baseline.

amount.description: The ticket's cost so far, up to the end of the period.

baseline.description: The median cost of similar past tickets.

ratio.description: Cost over baseline, such as `4.4` for four times as much.

similar_tickets.description: How many past tickets the baseline comes from.

unknown_model.description: Token entries on a model missing from the price table.

without_baseline.description: Tickets of the period with too few similar past tickets to compare.

PeriodSummary.description: A period and whether it is closed.

ended.description: Whether the calendar month is over.

blockers.description: Why it cannot close yet, in plain words.

can_close.description: Whether a controller can close it now.

PeriodView.description: One period, with what is still open in it.

project_overhead.description: On the project but on no ticket.

ProviderCheck.description: One provider's check: its bills against its token entries.

attribution_percent.description: The share of the gross that token entries explain, in percent.

bills.description:
The bills of the period from this provider, latest revision (or, for
a closed period, the revision it closed with).

gross.description: The bills' gross, at list price before discount and credit.

residual.description: Gross minus token entries: what no token entry explains.

token_entries.description: The list value of the provider's token entries.

token_entry_count.description: How many token entries were counted.

unknown_model_count.description:
Token entries on a model missing from the price table. Their cost is
unknown, so it sits in residual, never as zero.

restated_after_close.description:
Bills a provider restated after the period closed. The closed figures
stay as they were; a controller can post an adjustment.

RejectInput.description: Why a token entry goes back.

reason.example: This was the Globex pitch, not ACME: please move it to GLOBEX-7

Rejected.description: A token entry sent back to its agent manager.

local_id.description:
The local tool's ID for the session, so it can show the reason on the
draft.

exchange_rate.description: The rate from the reporting currency, when shown in another one.

adjustment.description: An adjustment posted to the closed period, shown as its own line.

share.description:
The line's share of the total in percent, such as `41.20`, in the
share view.

unknown_model.description: Token entries on a model missing from the price table.

value.description: The group, such as `web`; `null` for token entries without it.

rejected.description: Sent back with a reason: fix and submit again.

token_sheets.description: The person's token sheets, newest first.

filter.description: A tag filter in the URL form, such as `client:acme`.

SheetContext.description: What the local tools need to know about a person's token sheets.

SheetSummary.description: One of the person's token sheets.

SplitView.description: One split of a token entry.

StatusView.description:
Which counting token entries a report shows (docs: Report > Reading
reports, status).

TicketActual.description: The actual of one ticket behind a token budget.

ticket.description: The ticket key; `null` for cost on no ticket.

TokenBudgetDetail.description: One token budget opened down to what makes up its actual.

tickets.description: Actual per ticket, the largest first; they add up to actual.

token_entries.description: The token entries behind actual, with their own list value.

amount.description: The amount in the reporting currency, above zero, such as `1500.00`.

every_month.description: The amount applies to every month from `period` on.

filter.description:
The tag filter: tag names and values, such as `{"team": "web",
"client": "acme"}`. No tags is the whole organization.

name.description: A name to tell it apart, such as `Ana, monthly`.

period.description: The period, such as `2026-09`. Left out: all time, as for a ticket.

TokenBudgetReport.description: Token budget vs actual for one period.

rows.description: Token budgets overlap, so rows are never added up.

status.description: The view of token entries counted: `all` or `approved`.

TokenBudgetRow.description: One token budget against its actual.

actual.description:
What was spent, in the reporting currency: list value of the counting
token entries matching the filter, plus adjustments to closed
periods. Token entries on an unknown model are not in it.

actual_period.description:
The period actual is counted over; `null` for an all-time token
budget, which counts every period.

amount.description: The token budget in the reporting currency.

difference.description:
Actual minus token budget: above zero is an overrun, below zero an
underrun.

oneOf.description: `null` when token entries on an unknown model leave it open.

unknown_model_entries.description:
Token entries on a model missing from the price table: counted, but
their cost is not known, so it is not in `actual`.

TokenBudgetView.description: One token budget as the API shows it.

applies.description:
When it applies, in words: `2026-09`, `every month from 2026-09` or
`all time`.

every_month.description: The amount applies to each month from `period` on.

period.description:
The one period, or the first period of a token budget for every
month; `null` for all time.

token_forecast_id.description: The token forecast it was accepted from.

TokenEntriesPage.description: One page of token entries, oldest first.

total.description: Matching token entries on all pages.

available.description:
Whether this instance has an embeddings model configured. Without
one, token forecasts are off whatever `enabled` says.

enabled.description:
Whether the organization uses token forecasts: on unless a
controller switched them off.

reason.description:
Why token forecasts are off, in plain words; `null` while they are
on.

TokenForecastSettingsInput.description: Switches token forecasts on or off for the organization.

TokenForecastView.description: A token forecast for one ticket.

model.description: The embeddings model it compared with.

proposed.description:
The median actual cost of the matches with a known cost; `null` when
there is none.

Totals.description: The organization-wide figures, in the reporting currency.

estimates.description: List value of token entries without a bill, labelled an estimate.

net.description:
What the bills charged: token entries plus residual minus discount
and credit.

View.description: Money or shares of the period.
